item.title: Depression may be an early warning sign of Alzheimer's disease
item.description: Depression in older adults may be more than a mental health concern. Scientists discovered that accumulating tau protein, a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, was linked to worsening depressive symptoms in people who still had normal memory and thinking abilities. The faster tau built up in the brain, the faster depressive symptoms increased, suggesting that mood changes could emerge before cognitive decline. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Woman dies after lung cancer goes undetected on MRI; jury awards family $8 million
item.description: An Oregon jury awarded nearly $8 million to the estate of Wendi K. Lui and her husband after finding a radiology group and its hospital partner liable for missing a lung mass on her 2019 breast MRI. The cancer was detected during a scan in 2020, by which time it had spread to her lymph nodes. Lui died of metastatic lung cancer in 2023, aged 51. Her husband rejected settlement offers and pursued a trial to bring attention to the case. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

En España los trastornos de ansiedad son el problema de salud mental más registrado en la adolescencia, con 34,6 casos por cada 1.000 habitantes. Pero no es solo una cuestión española.
